title: RePT: 3D Geometry Emerges from 2D Relational Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.31601v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning spatial representations often relies on explicitly predicting geometric quantities, but how physical geometry is organized within learned representations remains less understood. We ask whether 3D structure can emerge from learning relations across 2D observations, without 3D prediction targets. We introduce RePT, which learns compact relations between distinct physical points through cross-view 2D point prediction. The learned relation space develops a geometric organization in which magnitudes, angles, and neighborhoods reflect physical 3D displacement. A single linear readout fitted on 16 scenes recovers displacement length and angle on 39 held-out scenes without refitting (Pearson r = 0.72 and 0.78). The ARKitScenes-trained checkpoint also retains strong geometric organization on ScanNet++, showcasing generalizability. translated_title: RePT：三维几何从二维关系预训练中涌现
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.31601v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：学习空间表示通常依赖于显式预测几何量，但物理几何如何在学到的表示中被组织起来仍知之甚少。我们探究三维结构能否从跨二维观测的关系学习中涌现，而无需三维预测目标。我们提出RePT，通过跨视角二维点预测来学习不同物理点之间的紧凑关系。学习到的关系空间形成了几何组织，其中幅值、角度和邻域关系能够反映物理三维位移。在16个场景上拟合的单一线性读出层，无需重新拟合即可在39个保留场景上恢复位移长度和角度（Pearson r 分别为0.72和0.78）。在ARKitScenes上训练的模型检查点在ScanNet++上也保持了强几何组织，展现了泛化能力。在受控比较中，不同点关系预测持续产生更强的几何组织。
tldr: RePT通过跨视角二维点预测学习物理点之间的关系，使三维几何结构无需三维预测目标即可从二维关系预训练中自然涌现，并展现出跨数据集的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: RePT learns compact relations between physical points via cross-view 2D point prediction, enabling 3D geometric structure to emerge from 2D relational pretraining without any 3D prediction targets, while generalizing across datasets.
